description: Audit-lane owned registry for Tier-A accepted non-axiom premise handling. Genuine admitted inputs are three: P1, AC_phi_lambda, and theta. The single dimensionful scale reference S (a^-1) was promoted 2026-05-30 to a framework primitive (the units import) in axiom_premise_nodes.json as scale_reference_primitive per AXIOM_MINIMALITY_POLICY.md section 6, and is no longer a Tier-A admitted input; its former not_a_node.S entry is kept below only as a pointer. Derivation targets are accepted as chain-satisfying premises at the bounded tier, so a clean row depending on one resolves to retained_bounded rather than retained_pending_chain; when a target is derived, remove its entry and compute_effective_status will auto-cascade dependents toward unbounded retained status when otherwise eligible. Y0 and g0 are vacuous rescaling conventions listed for survey completeness only: not admitted inputs, not derivation targets, not accepted premises, and not status-bounding dependencies. This registry is distinct from axiom_premise_nodes.json and from standard textbook theorems, which must earn retained-grade inline. Human-readable registry: docs/ADMITTED_INPUT_REGISTRY_TIER_A_NOTE_2026-05-23.md.

staggered_dirac_realization_gate_note_20.class: discrete flavor input with labeling convention stripped

strong_cp_theta_zero_note.statement: the QCD vacuum angle theta = 0 (strong-CP); also unsolved in the Standard Model

hypercharge_identification_note.statement: absolute hypercharge normalization (alpha=1/3); the retained structure fixes ratios, while the overall Y-scale is a Y <-> g' rescaling convention with no physical content by itself
hypercharge_identification_note.basis: koide_y_substrate_anomaly_forcing_note_2026-05-08_probey_substrate_anomaly (retained_bounded): anomaly fixes ratios not absolute normalization
